name: Hope Domain
body:
You have pledged yourself to bringing hope to those around you through word and action.

Granted Powers
Word of Hope (Su)

You can give a word of hope to a target within 30 feet as a standard action, granting a morale bonus on attack rolls, skill checks and Will saving throws equal to half your cleric level (minimum +1) for 1 round. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier. This is a mind-affecting, emotion and hope effect.

Word of Calming (Su)

At 8th level, you can utter a word to alleviate the fears and feelings of hopelessness a target within 30 feet feels as a standard action. You remove one fear or despair effect of your choice from the target (with the exception of curses). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier. This is a mind-affecting, emotion and hope effect.

Domain Spells: 1st-lesser good hope, 2nd-encouragement, 3rd–good hope, 4th-greater path of glory, 5th-shining beacon, 6th-greater good hope, 7th-hymn of peace, 8th–euphoric tranquility, 9th-beacon of life
